messages:
Hana: Dropping a new concept for the Roles Heatmap + bulk-invite flow. Big open items: how to indicate SSO requirements (lock icon vs badge), bulk CSV UX (preview + validation), and where "View changes" should navigate in Audit Logs. Figma: https://figma.com/file/roles-heatmap-bulk-v1
Dmitri: Love the heatmap for visibility. For SSO, prefer a small lock icon next to roles that require SSO, with an accessible label. Clicking lock opens a contextual panel that explains scope and offers a deep-link to Organization settings.
Priya: Accessibility note: lock icon alone can be ambiguous at small sizes. Add visible text on hover/focus like "SSO required (org)" and make the icon keyboard-focusable. Also ensure the icon meets 4.5:1 with text color or provide a contrast halo.
Omar: Regarding bulk CSV: we should show an inline preview of the first 10 rows and an errors pane. If a row tries to assign a role that requires SSO, show a row-level warning with a link to explain that role's SSO requirement. Do not let CSV silently drop enforcement.
Sasha: Keyboard flow: CSV upload -> preview table -> row-level error link -> focus moves into error list. Row warnings should be reachable by Tab and announced. For the lock panel, focus must be trapped and Esc returns to the lock icon. Ensure role cells are also navigable via arrow keys.
Noah: Backend can provide a small audit summary for the confirmation screen (last 5 related events) and also support deep-links to Audit Logs with params: actorId, action=invite, roleId, startTime, endTime, source=bulk-invite. We'll accept returnTo params so UI can restore the heatmap state.
Priya: Copy tweak: change confirmation toast from "Invites sent" to "Invites queued
Recipients will get emails within a few minutes." Add a persistent "Open invite status" link in the drawer header so keyboard users have a stable target. Toast must be aria-live="polite".
Dmitri: UX: when a row-level CSV warning appears for SSO, clicking the link should open a compact modal that explains: "This role requires SSO. Members added with this role must authenticate via SSO. Manage enforcement in Organization settings." Offer buttons: "Copy deep-link to settings" and "Open settings in a new tab".
Hana: Should the lock icon be interactive (open panel) or purely informational? I worry about users expecting to toggle it inline.
Omar: Make it interactive but not a toggle. The panel is informational + navigation. Dont present any control that implies per-invite SSO toggling. If we had a toggle UI, we'd need a warning overlay and a clear org-level callout. Better to avoid that complexity.
Sasha: A11y specifics: ensure the lock panel has role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby for heading, and the button that launches it has aria-expanded updated. Also the preview table needs aria-live updates when validation completes.
Noah: Deep-link examples I'll add to the design doc: /audit?actor=555&action=invite&role=designer&start=1672531200&source=bulk-invite. For return flow: add returnTo=heatmap&state=... so the UI can repopulate the selection and CSV preview. Backend will marshal a small token for return state to avoid long URLs.
VisualBot: Visual regression: roles-heatmap-bulk-v1 failed on lock-icon contrast and focus outline thickness. Snapshot: https://ci.internal/snapshots/2177777777/diff.png
Priya: Action items: (1) Dmitri update Figma: lock icon + panel copy + make icon tabbable, (2) Omar add CSV preview UX + row-warning designs, (3) Sasha write keyboard/ARIA flow for table, modal, and toast live regions, (4) Noah post deep-link and return-token API examples in the design doc, (5) Hana add copy for persistent invite status link. I'll run a quick sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to sign off. :thumbsup:
Dmitri: I'll post the updated frames later today.
Omar: Adding CSV validation examples to the spec PR.
Sasha: Will run axe once Dmitri posts updates.
Noah: Drafting API token flow and short examples now.
Hana: Thanks team, closing thread unless any blockers surface.
